visual_elements.description: 2D multi-class classification plot with x and y axes (arrows at ends, no visible axis labels). Hatched shaded regions separate classes. Yellow label boxes C1, C2, C3 placed near clusters. Orange boxes with "?" at four locations. "+ve" text near arrows/lines. Leader lines from "Undefined" box to plot regions.
Slide number indicator: white circle with purple outline containing black number "8".
Light blue rectangular box with dark border containing text "Undefined". Thin leader lines extend from box to regions inside the plot.
Purple rectangular box with dark border containing text "New Class".

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold and larger than body text. Title uses red for "Multi-Class Classification using" and "Binary Classifiers", and blue for "[ONE VS ALL]". Class labels in yellow boxes are bold black. Question marks in orange boxes are black. "+ve" labels are black.
animation_state: All elements appear static; no mid-build or partial reveal indicators visible.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#e6e6e6).
2. Add centered title at top: "Multi-Class Classification using" in red bold sans-serif, then "[ONE VS ALL]" in blue bold sans-serif on the same line, then "Binary Classifiers" in red bold sans-serif.
3. Add slide number "8" inside a white circle with purple outline at the top-right corner.
4. Draw a large white rectangle with a red border in the center for the plot area.
5. Inside the plot, draw x and y axes with arrowheads at the positive ends (no axis text labels visible).
6. Scatter green dots (C1) in the upper region, blue dots (C2) in the right region, and red dots (C3) in the lower-left region.
7. Draw three straight decision lines: red line d1(x) from upper-left to lower-right; blue line from lower-left to upper-right; green line d3(x) from lower-left to upper-right with a shallower slope than the blue line.
8. Add yellow rectangular labels "C1", "C2", and "C3" near their respective dot clusters.
9. Add four orange rectangular boxes each containing a black "?": one left-middle, one center, one upper-right, one bottom-center.
10. Add black "+ve" text near the green arrow on the left, near the blue arrow at top-right, and near the red arrow at bottom-right.
11. Add hatched shading to the background regions between decision lines as shown.
12. Place a light blue box labeled "Undefined" at the top-left outside the plot, with thin leader lines pointing into the plot regions.
13. Place a purple box labeled "New Class" at the middle-right outside the plot.
